title: Netflix Releases Teaser for 'Jão: Tales from the Void,' a Documentary About the Most Intimate Period of the Singer's Career
body_markdown:
São Paulo, September 25, 2026


— On Friday September 25, during the show marking Jão’s return to the stage in São Paulo, Netflix unveiled the first teaser for the documentary


Jão: Tales from the Void


, which is set to premiere in December. The production follows Jão's preparations for his return to the stage but also focuses on the period, lasting over a year, that he spent away from the limelight. Through intimate never-before-seen footage, the film captures the personal and professional moments that shaped his time away, including grieving his father, making his new album and his long-awaited reunion with fans.


Jão: Tales from the Void


, created and produced by UFO Sounds, marks a new chapter in the singer's career, reaffirming his status as one of the biggest names in Brazil’s pop music scene.
